leadText: Pokémon Adventures: The Pikachu Maneuver is the seventeenth monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Mato. It contains chapters thirty-eight and thirty-nine of the . The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of . As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.

It contains chapters thirty-eight and thirty-nine of the . The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of .
